title: A Novel Aggregated SIR Model for Spatial Epidemic Propagation
summary: We propose an extension of the classical susceptible infectious recovered (SIR) model that incorporates the effects of spatial propagation of an epidemic through a small number of additional compartments. The model is designed to capture the dynamics of disease spread across multiple interconnected cities or populated regions, while avoiding the high dimensionality and large parameter sets typical of network based or agent-based approaches.
